sloka: ततः पुस्फोट चर्मास्य प्रसुस्राव च शोणितम्।मुष्टिना तेन सञ्जज्ञे ज्वाला विद्युदिवोत्थिता ।। ६.७७.१७ ।।
transliteration: tataḥ pusphoṭa carmāsya prasusrāva ca śoṇitam।muṣṭinā tena sañjajñe jvālā vidyudivotthitā ।। 6.77.17 ।।

translations.english: By that blow, Nikumbha was not moved. Recovering from that he caught hold of Hanuman of extraordinary strength.
